chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from his father, from Sa'id ibn Janah, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah did not create any creature smaller than the mosquito, and the gnat is smaller than the mosquito, and that which you call the 'walgh' is smaller than the gnat. And whatever is in the elephant is also in it, and it was preferred over the elephant by having two wings.

key_terms.الْوَلْغَ: a very small fly or gnat

ai.seo_question: What are the smallest creatures created by Allah according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Tawhid*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) illustrates the subtlety of Allah’s creation by detailing a hierarchy of minute insects, noting that the mosquito contains all the parts of an elephant but is distinguished by its wings. This comparison serves as a tangible proof of Tawhid, demonstrating that the same Creator who designs the massive elephant can intricately replicate its complexity in a tiny, winged creature, thereby affirming divine unity through the marvel of biological design.
